sections.markdown:
## Right of way, passing and turning

FACT_ID: sec04-F01 | anchor: A01
Follow traffic signs and signals, but obey a police officer or firefighter directing traffic even when that direction differs from the devices. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F02 | anchor: A01
Do not drive on a road officially closed for construction, an event or another authorized reason. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F03 | anchor: A01
Right of way identifies who may make a traffic movement. Give way to prevent a collision even when another person fails to respect your lawful priority. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F04 | anchor: A01
At a stop sign where cross traffic does not stop, first stop and then yield to people or vehicles already in the intersection or close enough to make entry dangerous. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F05 | anchor: A01
At an uncontrolled intersection, when vehicles arrive together, the driver on the left yields to the driver on the right. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F06 | anchor: A01
At an all-way stop, yield to pedestrians and let vehicles proceed in arrival order. When vehicles arrive at about the same time, yield to the vehicle on your right. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F07 | anchor: A01
Take your turn at a stop-controlled intersection when safe, without needless delay. If another driver takes it, allow that vehicle to proceed rather than insist on priority. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F08 | anchor: A01
Turning left at a junction, or entering a driveway or alley on the left, requires yielding to opposing traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F09 | anchor: A01
At a yield sign, reduce speed enough for safety and be ready to stop. Stop when necessary and continue only with a safe opening. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F10 | anchor: A01
When merging without a stop, adjust speed and position to join safely. When another road merges into yours, move away if safely possible; otherwise adjust your speed and position to let the traffic join. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F11 | anchor: A01
A green signal does not authorize entering an occupied or unsafe intersection. Wait until the traffic conflict has cleared. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F12 | anchor: A01
Before entering or crossing a highway from a private road or alley, stop and yield to vehicles and pedestrians already using the road or sidewalk being crossed. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F13 | anchor: A01
For an emergency vehicle using a siren and emergency lights, slow, move safely to the shoulder or as far right as practicable, and stop. Avoid endangering others or blocking an intersection or the emergency vehicle's turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F14 | anchor: A01
In a construction area, yield to highway-maintenance workers and their vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F15 | anchor: A01
A right turn at a red traffic light is permitted unless the intersection has a sign prohibiting that turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=18]

FACT_ID: sec04-F16 | anchor: A02
A permitted turn on red requires a complete stop first, yielding to traffic and pedestrians, and a determination that the turn can be completed safely. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-F17 | anchor: A02
A left turn on red is permitted from the left lane of a one-way street to another one-way street carrying traffic to the left, unless a posted sign prohibits it. Stop, yield and confirm a safe opening first. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-F18 | anchor: A02
Flashing yellow school-bus lights warn approaching drivers to slow and prepare to stop, watching particularly for children beside or crossing the road. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-F19 | anchor: A02
When a school bus displays red flashing lights and its extended stop arms while loading or unloading, passing it is prohibited. Opposite-direction traffic across a dividing median need not stop, but must watch for children. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-F20 | anchor: A02
For the roadside emergency, sanitation or utility vehicles covered by the Move Over law, change to the next lane when safe. If a safe lane change is unavailable, drive below the posted limit and be ready to stop. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-F21 | anchor: A02
The described Move Over protection includes authorized emergency vehicles displaying flashing warning lights, and active sanitation or utility workers using cones or flashing-light vehicles. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

Misconceptions: A green light or lawful priority does not make an unsafe entry safe; being passed does not permit accelerating to block it.
Mnemonic: Look, yield, signal, move, then clear.
Glossary: A blind spot is checked by looking beyond the mirror view; a receiving lane is the lane entered after a turn.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Penalty amounts and the bicycle-passing speed comparison retain explicit verification debt; source diagrams are not reproduced.
